label: Obsidian & Silber — Desktop · Inventar & Ausrüstung
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, plausible, implementable UI redesign concept for the existing German dark fantasy idle RPG DARK RETURN. This is one of nine comparative concept mockups. Direction: Obsidian & Silber. Color palette and aesthetic: Cool neutral obsidian #101318, layered charcoal #1B2027, ivory #EEEAE0, brushed silver #AEB7C4. Restrained dark crimson #8F3F49 for primary actions. Very faint spectral light only around magic. NO brown panels, no golden interface borders. Quiet, refined dark gothic RPG.
Screen: Landscape 16:9 flat desktop game screenshot, full interface edge to edge. Compact left navigation width 190px with DARK RETURN logo, grouped readable links Welt, Kampfgruppe, Unterschlupf; highlight Ausrüstung. Main header Ausrüstung, with a compact Krieger / Heiler character selector, 10.000 Seelen and settings at upper right. Balanced usable three-column workspace: left 30% inventory with filter chips Alle, Waffen, Rüstung, Schmuck and a populated 4 by 4 grid of distinct illustrated fantasy items; center 38% full-body rugged adult warrior with sword and shield inside an atmospheric ruined gothic chamber, compact equipment slots thoughtfully arranged on either side; right 32% selected sword detail Eidbrecher, Episch · Schwert, +128 Angriff, +5 % Kritische Chance, clean comparison +24 Angriff, primary Ausrüsten and secondary Verbessern. Show equipped and selected states clearly. Low visual clutter, clear typography, restrained fine borders, no large empty panels. Art occupies meaningful space without making UI theatrical.
Art style: sophisticated painterly fantasy game illustration integrated into a crisp modern interface. Clear hierarchy: elegant serif headings, clean highly legible sans-serif body and numbers. Consistent spacing, icon family, selection states and controls. German interface copy exactly as specified where possible. Strong foreground/background contrast. Focus on usable game UI and meaningful visual progression; keep essential gameplay familiar. Screenshot is the entire image, front-on, no perspective, no desk, no device mockup, no explanatory annotations, no watermark, no concept board or collage. Do not reproduce the old brown-red panels. This is a NEW design exploration; use prior screenshots only as gameplay context.
